source_correction: Before opening any scientific wave, both documented public short1 and short2 standards are available to all models. Original DOI main.py used short1; current Git example used short2. Archive nominal mTRL, archived uncertainty driver and maintained implementation are distinct.
score_reference: arithmetic complex mean of all25 paired B@inv(A) sweeps independently for each standard
coverage: all299 measured increasing frequencies on 1–150GHz support, same exact axis across the roster
comparison_unit: two measured physical standard lengths on one substrate; within-standard sweeps measure temporal repeatability, not independent connection/geometry replicates
candidate: all exact unordered source triples; average order reversal in measured S, then nonnegative simplex sum-to-one minimizing trace of analytic Jacobian covariance from conditional independent standard sweep means; shared matrices propagate once per physical source; 1e-12 scaled diagonal for numerical tie resolution
primary: strict superiority on equal-length mean RMSE and maximum length RMSE against each other fixed arm, all ten gates jointly
admission: all source wave ids, clocks and 25 paired sweep rows valid; incident matrices condition<1e10; largest observed source chain perturbation spectral norm less than each mean chain minimum singular value at every frequency; all outputs finite, authentic apply_cal inverse residual≤1e−8, then content-hash complete predictions before held extraction
cost: separate runtime and source read rights for each arm, published full seven-line roster expressly changed to identical six sources; retained thirty-ohm family, embedded shorts and alternate DUT remain excluded
unmodelled: common nominal GSG pads; no independent identical launch, repositioning nor manufacturing-error bound; no empirical uncertainty guarantee
